chapter_note: Dominated by systematic cosmological time/eternity teaching: immeasurable durations of emanation (Great Spirit, Mother of Life, First Man, five sons), parallel durations of Matter’s uprising, and an eschatological sixfold schema (including the Last Statue and chaining). Later meta-institutional reflection about what “apostles/teachers” can or cannot speak (¶17–19, ¶30–32) appears to be a compilational/editorial layer. Several paragraphs retain minor second-person/teaching-address phrases that look like later delivery/frame residues but do not change the underlying cosmological mechanics (treated as MIXED).

paragraphs.core_text: [...] a great ju[d/ge ...] now also a ti[me ...] that they sculpt[ed ...] he was revealed in the Father, the first established thing.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fragmentary but stays within the cosmic system (“revealed in the Father,” “first established thing”); no institutional mapping or citation formula visible.

paragraphs.core_text: W[he]n [...] the two summonses that he called [...] the Mother of Life [...] a long duration in the first Father [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological emanation vocabulary (summonses, Mother of Life, Father) and duration language; no editorial address beyond lacunae.

paragraphs.core_text: For someone, if he might set a measure and rule [...] the earth {particles} and the {pebbles} of the mountains and [...] of the sea and the body of the firmaments. Should they be poured [...] the body of the four mountains and the three vessels that surround the universe; if they shall all be poured out [...] these fine {granules}.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal correspondential measuring analogy (particles/pebbles/mountains/vessels/firmaments) used to contrast measurable cosmos with immeasurable divine duration; internal cosmos→cosmos mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: Happen you know that the grains of the earth {particles} are measurable, [and those of] the [entire] universe. It is possible to count the {particles} of the earth each year [...] the sand grains of the entire universe; but the duration of the time that the Great Spirit spent in the Father, [the] first established thing, one will not be able to make a count of it!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core contrast between measurable created quantities and immeasurable pre-temporal duration in the Father; no institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: He first sculpted her like this. He established her in his inner storehouses in quiet and silence. When [they had] need of her she was called and came forth of the Father [of Greatness]. She looked at all her aeons of light!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic emanation mechanics (storehouses, calling/forth-coming, aeons of light) in impersonal expository voice.

paragraphs.core_text: Once again, from the time when she was called to [...] go to [...] she gave [...] upon his [bod]y [...] all the aeons [...]; she also [...] all of them. This [is also the case] with the First Man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Iterative process description (Mother of Life / First Man parallel) characteristic of substrate teaching sequences.

paragraphs.core_text: This is how the Man spent a long time being anointed in the Mother, set fast in her inner storehouses [...]; the extent of time —from when the First Man went down to the contest, till the time when the [Statue (?) co]mes i[n ...] this time [...] he appeared [...]
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed brief direct-address residue: “that I have recounted to you—” (delivery/frame voice), keeping the cosmological timeline statement intact.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying content is cosmic chronology (descent to contest; Last Statue horizon) but includes a first-person teaching aside that likely entered with oral/compilational framing.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, from when he was called and came forth, till the time when he [himse]lf called the five shining [gods] who are his sons; they themselves also spent a long time existing in their father! It is the time that occurred from the coming down of the First Man till the going up of the Last Statue. The five gods spent this much duration being anointed in the First Man. Yet, [at the] time when they were awaited, they were called and came forth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Classic core substrate: structured temporal spans tied to emanation sequence (First Man → five sons) and eschatological termini (Last Statue).

paragraphs.core_text: At the time when the Mother of Life was called from the Father of Greatness, when she expelled herself and came down by her own wish, from the heights of the Father to the earth, [she would spend thousands of] years and many ten thousands until she reached the earth. [Fo]r there is no measure nor rule to the heights of the Father. Rather, [just as] he had called her in his Great Spirit, so he set her upon [the] land of greatness through one of these three that are counted to the twelve hidden ones within the light veil, the ones [esta]blished after the [...] region of the south.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed opening teacher-address: “Listen also to this, how I would teach you it.” (delivery/frame voice).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological geography and measurement teaching (no measure to heights; twelve hidden ones; light veil; south region) is substrate-like; the removed clause is a later didactic wrapper.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] matter of the Mother [of L]ife is like this. When [the Father called her he established her in the place he pleased,] and she examined everywhere that [...] a blink of an eye, or like a [...] bird [...]
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed institutionalizing/pedagogical clause: “to establish her there as the instruction of the people that [...] many [...];” because it pivots from cosmic mechanics to didactic application (“instruction of the people”).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core here is the cosmic action/locomotion comparison (blink of an eye/bird-like swiftness). The excised segment is the only explicit reach toward ‘people’ as audience-in-world.

paragraphs.core_text: This also is lik[e ... the] Mother of Life in [...] whenever [...] cast her out [...] upon her to the place [...] him. He perfected her in his Great Spirit and set her in [the place he pl]eased, according to [his will].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Emanation/establishment language (“perfected,” “set,” “according to will,” “Great Spirit”) remains entirely within divine-cosmic process.

paragraphs.core_text: [Th]is [also is how] they called the [five g]ods from the [Fi]rst Man. They were set before him, as he wished that [...]-ness [...] down, that they would rule in them [...] one another. He ordered and distributed them [...] the son. He stripped himself of them [...] and he [...] he girt and bound himself to [...] in a [...] of silence upon the border of the earth [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic ordering/degree language (calling, setting, ruling, distributing, binding; border of the earth) in systematic exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, he too, the First Man, spent a long period and [time] until he gave power to his sons; until he assu[m]ed them. After he came to wear them he stood fast in the heights between the borders. Again, he spent a duration and time like this, corresponding to such amount and measure as the raindrops and dew and falls of mist that come down in the universe. This is how he spent this duration also, standing between the borders, until the hour when he cast himself down to the contest!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core correspondential measurement (raindrops/dew/mist as measure) tied to First Man’s empowerment/assumption of sons; impersonal mechanics despite vivid imagery.

paragraphs.core_text: Whenever the Father of Greatn[e]ss called the Great Spirit and the First Man and the gods of the glorious one, who are provided to enable them to reveal him; at that very time [he] sculpted the Great Builder in the [land of] light, [and] the Living Spirit with the mighty and active gods who came [from] him. Also, at that time, he sculpted the [Amb]assador, with Jesus the Splendour and the Virgin of Light and the Pillar of Glory, and the gods who came from them. [All these the Father of Greatness sculpted at] a single time. They came forth of one another, one after one; the time when [...] and the work.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic catalog of emanations and their simultaneity; “Jesus the Splendour” is a named cosmological being here (not a Gospel citation), fitting the core hierarchy exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: [...] to recount it to you [...] from the time when the Darkness raised itself up to [...] essence of the light [...] these three emanations [...] from the will of the Father against the enemy [...] he has [...] Darkness [...] according to the will [...] the universe [...] in it [...] separate out [...] rest him in which way, and he rejoices [...] in his kingdom; until [the time when the face] of the Father will be unveiled over [all] the gods of glory, and all the rich ones of [...] the em[anations] who came forth against the enemy.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Despite lacunae and a residual “to recount it to you,” the paragraph is chiefly a cosmic timeline from the uprising of Darkness to final unveiling; no institutional referents.

paragraphs.core_text: [From] that time when he sculpted these three [...] till the time when the Father would unveil his face, [and they] go in to his hidden storehouses, and he calls them [...] establishes each one of them to his place. There is no measure nor rule to this period until that time.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal duration statement and restoration-to-storehouses mechanics; characteristic of the substrate’s time/eternity contrast.

Meta-discourse about “teachers… saviours… apostles of greatness” and what they can proclaim; institutional vocabulary (“apostle”) indicates compilational/editorial framing rather than the oldest cosmological substrate.
Continues the same meta-authority theme (apostles/teachers speaking limits) regarding the eternal end; institutional register rather than pure system description.
Fragmentary question setup (“If a person shall ask…”) suggests Q/A or editorial prompting rather than core exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: ... about this Matter, this thought of death [...] for [this] is the way that [...] came up to its storehouses. It has [...] in its five elements.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed surrounding question/teaching-situation scaffolding (“to enable him to recoun[t ...] who asks him ... of the disciples ... which I have told you”) as later frame/delivery material; retained the cosmological point about Matter’s ascent and its five elements.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core substrate content is the structural account of Matter’s development and five-element constitution; the opening reads like an editor’s pedagogical setup.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, it also [...] the period and the time that it spent, until it revealed itself to its elements, before it came to the trees. It spent a great period and a long time established [...] before it came up to the trees. It was [...] in the trees. It spent a long time and duration [...] existing in them, before it sculpted the fru[its ...] and sculpted the fruits.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Parallel to the Light-side emanation durations: a stepwise temporal process for Matter (elements → trees → fruits), still cosmos→cosmos within Manichaean system.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, it spent a long [time] in the fruits. Not little is the period and the time that it spent existing in the fruits, before it sculpted [...] after a long time [...] the d[emon]s of its five worlds in various forms [can not (?) ] be measured [...] in p[erfec]tion of the fruits in the demons and fiends. They fell upon their earth and [...] were nourished. Not little is the period that they [spent in the wo]rlds, until they were nourished amongst [...] to make [...] that land which shines, and the great [King] who dwells there.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core evil-emanation mechanics: Matter’s maturation culminating in demons of five worlds; the imagery remains a process account rather than institutional polemic.

paragraphs.core_text: ... at the time when he [...] its essence. It assumed [...] Matter [...] to the war [...] the Perfect Man. [From the time] when the war occurred [...]
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed direct-address residue: “[You] know that ...” (delivery voice).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying content is a cosmological war sequence (Matter vs Perfect Man) consistent with core mythic mechanics; the address marker is later wrapper.

paragraphs.core_text: [The first is ...] he came to be in some [...] when they ensnared a [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Begins a numbered schematic (sixfold list) typical of core structural teaching, though heavily lacunose.

paragraphs.core_text: [The second is ...] that he built [...] the universe was established. The zone [...] down until the time when it will be dissolved.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues schematic temporal stages (establishment → dissolution) in impersonal cosmic register.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is the [...] the things and the universe will [...] from the time when they were established there, till the time when their end will be complete and their existence ceases [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Another stage in the temporal schema; purely cosmological.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fourth is the dissolution when they will dissolve the universe] there, and all things are destroyed. Obliteration reaches them in that great fire, [which will] burn them for fourteen hundred and sixty-eight years.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eschatological mechanics with specific duration; still system-internal (cosmic fire and dissolution), not institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fift]h is the way that the Last Statue will be sculpted [from] the remnant of all things. The light separates out to its place, and goes up and rules in its kingdom. However, [the da]rkness [...] and they take it in to the tomb [...] and they are bound with it in an eternal chain.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Classic core end-time mechanism (Last Statue; separation of Light; chaining of Darkness). Capitalized Darkness as a personified cosmic power.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, from [the tim]e when this first war occurred, till the time of this chain [...] these five things [...] light.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summative temporal span linking primordial war to final chaining; remains cosmological summary.
Reintroduces institutional authorities (“apostles and the chosen and the teachers”) as the ones who can speak; this is meta-commentary on proclamation rather than core system description.
Fragment continues the ‘no person is able…’ meta-speech about the eternal chaining; likely part of the same editorial reflection on who can speak.
Explicit “the apostle and the teacher” language marks compilational layer; not the oldest impersonal substrate voice.
